newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- Wilton, Conn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Wilton, Conn..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Town of Wilton, Connecticut, at the office of the First Selectman, Wilton Town Hall, 238 Danbury Road, Wilton, Connecticut, subject to the provisions of the official Notice of Sale dated June 27, 1997.
Maturities: $205,000 on July 15 in each of the year 1999-2012,
Interest Paid: July 15 and January 15 in each year commencing

The Bonds shall NOT be designated by the Town as qualified tax exempt obligations under the provisions of Section 265 (b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, for purposes of the deduction by financial institutions for interest expense allocable to the Bonds.
For copies of the official Notice of Sale, the Official
Statement of the Town of Wilton, Connecticut, dated June 27, 1997, and bid form, please contact Mr. Richard G.
Christensen, Vice President, People's Bank, Municipal
Banking and Finance, 850 Main Street, Bridgeport,
